title: Great Montserrat Experience
text: Elvira our guide was excellent. She is very informative and answered all our questions. She is a very happy person and helped us understand the culture and region of Catalonia. She made us feel welcomed and this was important since it was our first time in Barcelona. Thank you for such an amazing experience.
author: jorgegN3508BC

title: Great time and awesome guide!
text: We had an amazing tour with Elvira! She was awesome and extremely knowledgeable! Make sure to request her. She picked us up infront of the hotel and dropped us off at the end of the day. She took us to a local restaurant between the caves and monestary.  These places are special and a must place to visit when traveling to Barcelona. Overall great time!
author: Robert_L

title: Amazing Tour and best guide ever!
text: What can I say, we had an awesome time with Elvira! If you can request her, you will be amazed! Super friendly and knowledgeable about all aspects of Barcelona and Catalunya. She made everything so easy from picking us at the hotel to getting us to the caves and lastly to Monserate. I forgot to mention we also had a lunch between the caves and monestary at La Santa Cova which is a local restaurant. We couldn't ask for a better guide. Overall an excellent day!
author: rlag2002

title: The Hidden Treasures of Barcelona and Catalan
text:
Elvira was a wonderful guide.  Her wealth of knowledge of Catalan and its people along with Monserrat and the food of the region made our experience unforgettable.  She also took us to a winery that was a hidden treasure.  The reserved red they had was truly a find.

Also, if you have her as a guide, be sure to ask her for her recommendations for restaurants and bakeries.  Every one we went to were delicious and unique.
author: 634kleinl

title: Great tour guide for Montserrat.
text: Elvira was a wonderful tour guide. She was attentive and really worked to give us the best experience at Monserrat possible - although it was a rainy day. She gave us lots historical and cultural information about the general area as well. Great tour guide!

author: George S

title: Elvira was an excellent local  guide!
text: Elvira is a local from Catalonia and  provided us with an excellent tour! We had a wonderful time on our tour and appreciate all the interesting insight you provided. The highlight of the tour was the hike and especially the delicious paella with roasted spring onion lunch  at the winery.  I would highly recommend Elvira!
author: chrislong2018

title: LIVE LIFE
text: Our first time to Europe. Elvira was our tour guide to Monserrat and after to a family owned winery and brunch. She was fantastic. She is from Barcelona so she was very knowledgeable of all the things to do and see here. She was able to set up a blessing for our family by Father George at Monserrat which was so special. We are so thankful to her and all of Barcelona for a memorable trip. I highly recommend choosing Elvira to be your guide.
author: 75jolenek
